verdict.rationale: Appwrite's docs explicitly state it was designed for self-hosting via Docker CLI, with one-click marketplace deployments and full control over data location, and this is corroborated by hands-on community testimony praising the self-hosting guide/experience. Missing for 10: no independent audit of feature parity between self-hosted and cloud versions, and one community comment questions whether self-hosted counts as 'true' BaaS.
